title: From Relation-Specific Heads to Shared Interventions: Contextual Entrainment in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18674v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models rely on prompt context to perform in-context learning, follow formats, and adapt to local evidence. This ability, however, also raises a robustness concern: models may reuse irrelevant tokens from earlier context when answering a later query. Prior work identifies this behavior as contextual entrainment and finds attention heads whose ablation reduces it, arguing that these heads are largely task- or relation-specific. But are the mechanisms behind contextual entrainment truly isolated by relation, or do relation-conditioned searches recover reusable components shared across relations? Using factual-distractor relation-completion prompts across 19 lexical-semantic subtypes, we identify attention heads whose ablation reduces entrainment and test how the resulting head sets transfer recovery ability across exact relations, semantic families, and mixed relation distributions. translated_title: 从关系特定注意力头到共享干预：语言模型中的上下文夹带现象
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型依赖提示上下文来执行上下文学习、遵循格式并适应局部证据。然而，这种能力也引发了鲁棒性方面的担忧：模型在回答后续查询时可能会复用早期上下文中不相关的词元。先前的研究将这种行为识别为“上下文夹带”，并发现消融某些注意力头可以减少该现象，认为这些注意力头在很大程度上是任务特定或关系特定的。但上下文夹带背后的机制是否真的按关系相互隔离？还是说基于关系的搜索能够恢复跨关系共享的可复用组件？我们使用覆盖19个词汇-语义子类型的事实性干扰项关系补全提示，识别出消融后能减少夹带的注意力头，并测试由此得到的注意力头集合如何在精确关系、语义族以及混合关系分布之间迁移其恢复能力。同族迁移的效果超过不同族……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究发现减少语言模型上下文夹带的注意力头机制并非严格按关系隔离，而是存在跨关系共享的可复用组件，且同语义族之间的干预迁移效果优于不同语义族之间。
en_tdlr: The study shows that attention heads reducing contextual entrainment in language models are not strictly relation-specific but share reusable components across relations, with intervention transfer being stronger within the same semantic family.
